reviews.text: The Maruti Suzuki Brezza continues to be one of the strongest contenders in the highly competitive compact SUV segment. It combines bold SUV styling, Maruti Suzuki's trusted reliability, and excellent fuel efficiency, making it a practical choice for both city and highway driving. One of its biggest highlights is that the Smart Hybrid automatic variants deliver better claimed fuel efficiency than the manual versions, which is uncommon in this segment. Available in LXI, VXI, ZXI, and ZXI+ variants, the Brezza caters to a wide range of buyers with different budgets and feature requirements.

The Brezza features a bold, boxy SUV design with an upright stance that gives it a commanding road presence. The LXI and VXI variants come equipped with halogen projector headlamps, a shark fin antenna, body-colored bumpers, door handles, ORVMs, and 16-inch steel wheels with wheel covers. The ZXI introduces LED projector headlamps with dual-function LED DRLs, roof rails, an electric sunroof, and 16-inch alloy wheels. The flagship ZXI+ further upgrades the styling with precision-cut alloy wheels and LED front fog lamps. Buyers can choose from seven monotone color options along with three dual-tone roof combinations available on the ZXI and ZXI+ variants.

The Brezza offers a spacious cabin with excellent headroom thanks to its tall roofline, while the 2500 mm wheelbase provides generous legroom for passengers. The 328-litre boot is practical for everyday family use. The LXI comes with power windows, tilt-adjustable steering, electrically adjustable ORVMs, rear AC vents, and a 60:40 split-folding rear seat with a center armrest. The VXI adds automatic climate control, a height-adjustable driver's seat, electrically folding ORVMs, and adjustable rear headrests. The ZXI enhances comfort with telescopic steering adjustment, cruise control, keyless entry with push-button start, and a premium dual-tone cabin. The top-end ZXI+ adds a leather-wrapped steering wheel, ambient lighting, cooled glovebox, rear USB charging ports, and a Head-Up Display (HUD).

Powering the Brezza is Maruti Suzuki's proven 1.5-litre, four-cylinder naturally aspirated petrol engine. Manual variants produce 100 PS of power and 137 Nm of torque, while Smart Hybrid versions deliver 103 PS and 139 Nm of torque. The engine offers smooth performance, refined operation, and strong low-speed drivability, making it ideal for city conditions. Buyers can choose between a 5-speed manual gearbox or a smooth 6-speed torque converter automatic transmission. Factory-fitted CNG variants are also available on the LXI, VXI, and ZXI trims, producing 88 PS and 122 Nm of torque.

The Brezza continues Maruti Suzuki's reputation for low running costs. The Smart Hybrid automatic variants deliver excellent claimed fuel efficiency, outperforming many competitors in the compact SUV segment. For buyers seeking maximum economy, the factory-fitted CNG variants offer an impressive claimed fuel efficiency of 25.51 km/kg, making them one of the most economical SUVs to own.

• 9-inch SmartPlay Pro+ touchscreen infotainment system
  • Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
  • Arkamys Surround Sense premium sound system
  • Wireless smartphone charging pad
  • Electric sunroof
  • Head-Up Display (HUD)
  • Cruise control with push-button start
  • 360-degree surround-view camera (ZXI+)
  • Automatic climate control
  • Suzuki Smart Hybrid technology

Safety is one of the Brezza's strong points. Every variant comes equipped with Electronic Stability Control (ESC), Hill Start Assist, ISOFIX child seat mounts, and impact-sensing auto door unlock as standard. Dual front airbags are available across the lower variants, while the top-spec ZXI+ offers six airbags, including side and curtain airbags. The ZXI also adds a rear parking camera, rear wiper, and washer, while the flagship ZXI+ enhances convenience further with a 360-degree surround-view camera.

The Brezza is tuned for comfort and confidence on Indian roads. Its suspension absorbs potholes and rough surfaces with ease, while the 200 mm ground clearance allows it to tackle speed breakers and uneven roads comfortably. The light steering makes city driving effortless, and the 6-speed torque converter automatic delivers smooth gear shifts, making stop-and-go traffic significantly more relaxed.

The LXI is ideal for budget-conscious buyers who prefer customizing their SUV with aftermarket accessories. The VXI offers additional convenience features but does not provide the best value for its price. The ZXI stands out as the best value-for-money variant, offering LED lighting, alloy wheels, a sunroof, wireless connectivity, cruise control, and premium features that justify the price increase. The flagship ZXI+ is recommended for buyers who prioritize maximum safety, luxury, and technology, including six airbags, a 360-degree camera, a Head-Up Display, and the larger 9-inch infotainment system.

The Maruti Suzuki Brezza remains one of the most balanced compact SUVs in the Indian market. It combines SUV styling, refined performance, excellent fuel efficiency, practical features, and Maruti Suzuki's extensive service network. The ZXI variant offers the best balance between price and features, making it the most recommended choice for the majority of buyers. Those seeking additional luxury and advanced safety equipment can confidently choose the ZXI+.

Best Variant to Buy: ZXI (Manual, Automatic, or CNG)
Best For: Family buyers, city commuters, and long-distance travelers looking for a reliable compact SUV with low ownership costs.
Verdict Rating: 8.6 / 10 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
